gaps.explanation: Gap 122,874 is depreciation. The p7 proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis prints Total operating expenses 483,340 including Depreciation 122,874 (2022 Total column). The budgetary comparison schedules (budgetary basis) print no depreciation: Water Fund p17 total expenditures 175,303 + Sewer Fund p18 114,108 + Garbage Fund p19 71,055 = 360,466 = detail. 483,340 - 122,874 = 360,466 (exact). Every other object line ties: Personal services 53,688 + 53,575 + 311 = 107,574; Contractual 75,569 + 9,242 + 69,574 = 154,385; Utilities 8,512 + 24,901 = 33,413; Repairs 2,623 + 6,543 = 9,166; Other supplies 34,911 + 19,847 + 1,170 = 55,928. No fix (depreciation is not printed on any schedule).
